name: logo_marks
does: Brand marks from real letters for a name (or acronym): every font x five layouts (word, tile = app icon, badge, stack, cut), plus one contact sheet to look at

fonts.description: 3-4 font ids that fit the brief (font_list shows them)

layouts.description: any of word tile badge stack cut (default all)
